meta.title: Opening a file causes subsequent completion failures
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#53001 (ScriptInfo versioning improvements, 1da6d87a05, 2023-03-01; first stable release 5.1.3); #53472 (3a3146e25f) only adds the regression tests and says the crash was fully fixed by #53001
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.0.4 and typescript@5.1.3, both behind typescript-language-server@3.3.2 (the latest wrapper release before 5.1.3); the wrapper is started with the pinned tsserver.js and the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. git tag --contains 1da6d87a05: first in v5.1-beta / v5.1.3, not in any 5.0.x.
meta.notes: Opening utils.ts swaps its script-info backing store; the next program update re-parses it, so the cached export-info map holds a stale module symbol and the class-member completion with an auto-import fails with 'Debug Failure' in addImportFromExportedSymbol.

settings_note: The issue asks for completions with auto-imports and class member completions; both are on in the tsserver preferences of the kind (servers_bench.TSSERVER_PREFERENCES, the wrapper defaults).

repro.steps: 1. Request completions (auto-imports and class member completions) at /**/ in classes.ts (line 3, character 10). 2. Open utils.ts, which was only part of the program so far. 3. Erase a single character at the marker (the 'r' of render). 4. Request completions again: in the report this request fails with 'Debug Failure' in addImportFromExportedSymbol. The probe is the failed request itself (an error response to the fourth step).
